definition.title: Container Endpoint
definition.description: Attaches one stable HTTPS root URL to one exact ContainerService Resource incarnation. The `service` reference pins edge.forms.takoform.com/ContainerService@0.1.0 and is immutable for this endpoint; at most one live endpoint may attach to a service. The host-assigned canonical hostname and root URL both remain immutable for the endpoint's UID. Requests route to the referenced service's health-selected serving generation, so workload-generation cutover does not change the URL. If a service is deleted and recreated under the same name with a new UID, the endpoint MUST NOT retarget to that replacement. Delete the endpoint to detach it; deleting a service while this attachment is live is refused as dependency_in_use, and detaching never deletes the service. HTTPS uses its standard root port 443; no plaintext address is provided. This endpoint is not an authentication, authorization, or secret-delivery contract and declares no Worker Interface or Binding.

service.description: Exact ContainerService resource this endpoint attaches to. The group, kind, definition version, and schema digest are pinned by this Form. It is immutable: use a new endpoint UID to change the service. The relation remains fenced to the resolved service UID; a same-name replacement does not become its target. At most one live ContainerEndpoint may hold this service.

desiredSchema.title: Container Endpoint desired state

outputSchema.description: Host-computed values this Form publishes in status.outputs. Every member is returned by a conforming host; the object is closed.

hostname.description: Canonical dotted DNS hostname assigned by the host. It is immutable for the lifetime of this endpoint UID, including service generation cutover, and is not reconstructed from the resource name.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS root URL exactly `https://` plus the assigned canonical hostname plus `/`. The scheme is HTTPS with the standard port 443 and no explicit port; hostname and URL are immutable for this endpoint UID and the URL routes to the referenced service's health-selected generation.

outputSchema.title: Container Endpoint outputs

localLifecycleFixtures.name: healthy-service-generation-routes
localLifecycleFixtures.scenario: The referenced ContainerService has a health-selected serving generation.
localLifecycleFixtures.expected: The endpoint's stable HTTPS root URL routes to that service's health-selected serving generation.

localLifecycleFixtures.name: same-name-new-service-uid-does-not-retarget
localLifecycleFixtures.scenario: The referenced service is deleted and a new ContainerService incarnation is created with the same group, kind, and name.
localLifecycleFixtures.expected: The existing endpoint remains fenced to the exact original service UID and is not silently retargeted to the replacement.

localLifecycleFixtures.name: service-delete-with-live-endpoint-is-refused
localLifecycleFixtures.scenario: A service deletion is requested while its exclusive ContainerEndpoint attachment remains live.
localLifecycleFixtures.expected: The service delete is refused as dependency_in_use; deleting the endpoint removes only the attachment.

localLifecycleFixtures.name: missing-host-assigned-output-is-refused
localLifecycleFixtures.scenario: A response omits hostname or url from the required host-assigned outputs.
localLifecycleFixtures.expected: The missing output is rejected; both hostname and URL are required and remain immutable for this endpoint UID.

localLifecycleFixtures.name: wrong-target-or-schema-digest-is-unresolved
localLifecycleFixtures.scenario: The exact ContainerService FormRef is absent from the Core Snapshot or its schema digest differs.
localLifecycleFixtures.expected: Core produces no partial Snapshot and reports the exact target reference unresolved.
